drivingQuestion: Is the dispute over exposing the sota a dispute about concern for illicit thoughts?
outcomeNote: contradiction and resolution follow in sotah.sugya037

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אִם הָיָה לִבָּהּ וְכוּ׳. לְמֵימְרָא דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה חָיֵישׁ לְהִרְהוּרָא, וְרַבָּנַן לָא חָיְישִׁי?
segments.en: The mishna continues by citing that «Rabbi Yehuda says: If her heart was» attractive he would not reveal it, and if her hair was attractive he would not unbraid it. The Gemara asks: «Is this to say that Rabbi Yehuda,» who maintains that it is prohibited to uncover an attractive woman, «is concerned about» onlookers having sexual «thoughts, and the Rabbis,» who permit it, «are not concerned» about this?
